# user

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.filters.user`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(users: Union[int, str, List[Union[int, str]]] = None): ...
```

## Documentation

Filter messages coming from one or more users.

You can use [set bound methods](https://docs.python.org/3/library/stdtypes.html#set) to manipulate the
users container.

### Parameters

- **`users`** (`int` | `str` | `list`)
  Pass one or more user ids/usernames to filter users.
  For you yourself, "me" or "self" can be used as well.
  Defaults to None (no users).
